tagline: Load a local song, tap lyric timings, export LRC. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Open a song from this computer. Paste the unsung lyrics. Play, and press Stamp (or Space) as each line is sung. The times land on the line. Export writes an .lrc file you can take to a player.

The song never leaves this device. The lyrics and stamps live in the app, so you can close it and come back.

Want a friend looking at the same sheet? Press Play together, then Invite (in the GifOS menu). They get the words and times, not the audio file.

An unofficial port of lrc-maker.
